purpose: Replaces the guided CMPI 0.40/0.40/0.20 hand-weighting with an XGBoost that fuses the tasks
deploy_limitations: tap: the device tap test only stores tap times/amplitudes, no continuous acceleration spectrum -> the 4 tap features are median-imputed on-device (effectively equal to rest+posture ~0.78)
Lower than the deployed LiftHold single-task XGBoost (0.845): LiftHold is this device strongest single task
Sampling rate: the device 200Hz is decimated to 100Hz to align with PADS training; gyro deg/s->rad/s aligned
domain gap not re-validated on the device own measured data
